name: Forminit Free
free_limit: 1 hosted form, 100 submissions per month and 100 MB file storage; includes file uploads, email notifications, workflow, redirects, validation and spam protection.
watch_out: Free plan is described for personal projects and trying Forminit; commercial use is not confirmed. Pro plan is required for 5,000 monthly submissions and 15 forms. No credit card required for free signup.
